Definition: probably from G537; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively):--once.
BiblicalUsage: Hapax means once, one time only, and Hebrews builds the whole argument of the cross on it. In Hebrews 9:26 Christ appeared once to put away sin, in Hebrews 9:27 it is appointed unto men once to die, and in Hebrews 9:28 Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many. Peter adds in 1 Peter 3:18 that Christ suffered once for sins, the just for the unjust.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe once is the most comforting word in the Bible, because it means the sacrifice does not need repeating. He did it once, and it was enough.
